translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content: Nkunga wu maniongo wu Davidi kayimbidila Yave mu diambu di KUSI, muisi dikanda di Benzami.

content.text: A Yave, Nzambi ama,
kuidi ngeyo ndintombilanga suamunu kiama.
Wuphukisa mu babo beti kundandakana ayi wukhula.
Muingi babika ku khanzuna banga khosi
ayi kunzenga mu bitini mu kambu mutu wulenda vukisa.
A Yave, Nzambi ama, enati ndivengi mawu
ayi enati nzimbala yidi mu mioko miama ;
enati ndivutudi mambimbi kuidi mutu
wubedi zinganga yama mu ndembama,
voti ndiziona, mu kambu bila, bima bi mutu wundenda,
buna bika mbeni ama kandandakana
ayi kambakidila ;
bika kadiatidila luzingu luama va tsi,
ayi kandekisa mu mbungi-mbungi.
A Yave, telama ku tsi nganzi aku,
Nuanisa miangu mi ngolo mi bambeni ziama.
A Nzambi ama, kotuka
bika wundungisa.
Bika lukutukunu lu batu bazungidila,
bika wuba yadila bu widi ku diyilu
Bika Yave wusambisa batu
A Yave, wutsambisa boso buididi busonga buama
ayi boso buididi fuanana kuama, a Nzambi yizangama
A Nzambi yi busonga,
ngeyo wumfionguninanga mintima
ayi mayindu ma batu, manisa makhemi ma mutu wumbimbi
ayi tula mutu wusonga mu luvovomo.
Nzambi yizangama niandi nkaku ama ;
niandi wumvukisanga batu babo badi mintima milulama.
Nzambi niandi zuzi disonga,
Nzambi wummonisanga miangu miandi mu kadika lumbu.
Enati kakadi balula mavanga,
wela lengula sabala kiandi,
wela leki mbasꞌandi ayi kuwukubika.
Wukubika binduanina biandi bi lufua
wulembo kitula madionga mandi madionga ma mbazu.
Niandi widi mu buemba bu mambimbi ;
widi mu kubika ziphasi
ayi butidi mambu ma luvunu.
Niandi wukaba dibulu ; wudikulula dimula
ayi wubua mu dibulu di kakaba niandi veka.
Ziphasi ziozi kakubika zimbuididi niandi veka
ayi tsitꞌandi yibuidi va dikosi diandi.
Ndiela vutudila Yave matondo mu diambu di busonga buandi.
Ayi ndiela yimbidila nzitusu wu dizina di Yave wuzangama.
